Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel art sprite atlas for a browser electronic music groovebox. Create ONE square sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells. Orthographic front view, isolated sprites centered well inside each cell with 15% transparent padding, no object crosses cells. Truly transparent background. Crisp deliberate 16-bit pixel art with blocky edges, no blur, no text, no letters, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows outside sprites. Dark graphite equipment, warm ivory details, acid lime LEDs, orange and lavender accents. Row 1: four animation frames of the SAME compact drum machine, first idle then progressively illuminated orange pads and small meter. Row 2: four animation frames of the SAME bass synthesizer module with lime display, first idle then increasingly active lime waveform and knobs. Row 3: four animation frames of the SAME compact keyboard synthesizer with lavender LEDs, first idle then progressively glowing keys. Row 4: four animation frames of the SAME twin reel tape delay unit with orange reels rotating and green level LEDs. Distinct crafted retro studio machines, detailed readable silhouettes, consistent scale and top lighting, limited color palette. This is an atlas to be programmatically cropped on a strict uniform 4 by 4 grid, not an illustration of a whole room.
